E0413

`priv` used outside a `#PubFile` file (D-VISDEFAULT2)

What

`priv` used outside a `#PubFile` file (D-VISDEFAULT2)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0413

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0413: tests/ui/pub_file_priv_without_marker.stderr.

Error [E0413]: `priv` only applies inside a `#PubFile` file
  --> tests/ui/pub_file_priv_without_marker.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | priv fn secret() Int -> 0
    | ^^^^
 Why: without `#PubFile`, items are private by default and export with `pub`
 Fix: add `#PubFile` at the top of the file, or write `pub` instead of `priv`
